text:
Your $shipOrFleet approaches the mysterious gate.

The gate does not appear to connect, or have ever connected, to the domain network.

This autonomous warning beacon emits a looping message.

"Enterance to this system is forbidden by Iskalan Naval Diktat 47. All tresspassers will be eliminated on sight."

You call into the office of the Cesarz, and are answered by a secretary, who tells you that the Cesarz is currently unavailable, however the Vice President of the Terraforming Burreu is looking for captains who have proven themselves to assist him.
